newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Cossack crude production cut in half to 40,000 bpd.
newsitem.headline: Cossack crude production cut in half to 40,000 bpd.

text.p: SINGAPORE, MAY 2 (REUTER) - Production at Australia's offshore Cossack crude field has been cut in half to 40,000 barrels per day (bpd) owing to technical problems, traders said on Friday.
Traders said the exact nature of the technical problem was not clear and that news of the reduced production had been filtering through all week.
The field was producing at 80,000 to 90,000 bpd before the cut back, traders said.
The field has been shut down at various times in the past six months owing to the Australian typhoon season.
The field also had problems earlier this year with its gas dehydration system, which required production to be cut to around 40,000 bpd.
